about: Regulators' innovation services that help firms bring new products to market (sandboxes, advice offices, single front doors), each from the regulator's own page, read 22 November 2026.

services.name: Regulatory Sandbox
services.what: For firms wanting to test new financial products live in the market with real consumers; open to authorised and unauthorised firms of all sizes, and to technology businesses serving financial services.

services.name: Innovation Pathways
services.what: Help for firms that are not ready to test but need to understand how financial services regulation applies to an innovative proposition.

services.name: Digital Sandbox
services.what: Access to synthetic data sets to test and develop technology solutions for financial services.

services.name: Innovation Office
services.what: Free and confidential expert regulatory advice for developers of innovative medicines, medical devices and novel manufacturing processes.

services.name: Regulatory Sandbox
services.what: A free service for organisations creating products and services that use personal data in innovative and safe ways.

services.name: Innovation advice service
services.what: Fast, direct data protection advice for organisations doing new or innovative things with personal data.

services.name: Energy Regulation Sandbox
services.what: Lets innovators trial or bring to market new energy products, services, business models and methodologies without some of the usual rules applying.

services.name: Front Door
services.what: Helps innovative science and technology businesses raise regulatory barriers that are slowing the development, launch or growth of new products in the UK.
